text:
anna: Heads-up — we're rolling an RBAC tweak to the `backup-uploader` role this Thu 02:00 UTC. Please flag if this could break snapshot restores (esp cross-account/KMS-grant paths). cc @sec-team
charlie: Quick q — does the change add any deny rules or remove `kms:Decrypt` from the service principal?
devon: we've seen intermittent decrypt errors in CI when we rotated ephemeral grants last month, worth validating key policy + grants before deploy.
sec-team: Can you paste the minimal policy diff and a failing log (if any)? we'll run a quick audit-log search for preexisting deny events.
anna: policy diff below (only the changed block) + example restore error from staging. Not changing key policy, just restricting who can assume `backup-uploader` role.
```json
-    "Action": "sts:AssumeRole",
-    "Resource": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/backup-uploader"
+    "Action": "sts:AssumeRole",
+    "Condition": {
+      "StringEquals": { "aws:PrincipalTag/team": "platform" }
+    }
```
```text
2026-01-18T11:12:03Z restore-agent[pid=1423] ERROR KMSDecryptFailed: AccessDeniedException: Access denied for key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-...
    at kmsClient.Decrypt (kms.go:213)
```
charlie: That Condition will block cross-account service accounts unless they have the tag. If backups use an ephemeral cross-account role (we do for tenant restores), they'll be blocked.
devon: So two risks: (1) requestor cannot assume role -> no restore; (2) assume succeeds but KMS grants missing -> decrypt fails. We saw #2 earlier, but #1 would be immediate.
sec-team: Proposed mitigations before change: add a canary window + allowlist for known cross-account ARNs, add CloudTrail detection for `sts:AssumeRole` failures and `KMS AccessDenied` events, pre-seed a temporary KMS grant (if supported) for the migration window.
anna: Draft canary checklist I'm proposing: 1) Create a canary role binding for tenant-restore-service with the `team:platform` tag; 2) Run three test restores from different accounts (same region, cross-account, cross-region); 3) Verify CloudTrail shows AssumeRole success + `Decrypt` event for the key; 4) Monitor `restore_success` metric and a synthetic traffic check; 5) Rollback steps documented.
devon: Can you drop the restore commands we'll run? I can script them into the runbook.
anna: Commands (quick):
```bash
# assume as tenant restore service
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::210987654321:role/tenant-restore-service --role-session-name canary-test --duration-seconds 900
# kick a snapshot restore (internal CLI)
./rdctl snapshot restore --snapshot-id snap-20260112-abc --target tenant-42 --region us-west-2
# check decrypt events in CloudTrail (pseudo)
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Decrypt --start-time 2026-01-18T00:00:00Z
```
charlie: Detection query for logs (quick pseudo-SQL for observability):
```sql
SELECT eventTime, userIdentity.arn, eventName, errorCode
FROM cloudtrail_events
WHERE (eventName = 'AssumeRole' AND errorCode IS NOT NULL)
   OR (eventName = 'Decrypt' AND errorCode LIKE '%AccessDenied%')
ORDER BY eventTime DESC
LIMIT 100
```
sec-team: Also add an alert: if restorations fail > 1 in 10 during the canary, abort and roll back RBAC change. Include paging list for oncall.
anna: I will schedule the window and create a temp allowlist for the three known cross-account ARNs. Can @devon and @charlie own the test scripts + post results here?
devon: I'll own the test script and automation. will post logs after run.
charlie: I'll add the CloudTrail detection rule and an ad-hoc dashboard tile for the Decrypt errors.
ops-bot: Change scheduled: RBAC tweak for `backup-uploader` role on 2026-01-22T02:00:00Z. Change ID CHG-20260122-48. Watch channel for canary updates. :robot_face:
sec-team: Thanks — please annotate the ticket with KMS key ARNs used and the CloudTrail rule ID. Also attach any post-mortem if we see anomalies.
anna: noted. will update CHG and ping oncall 15m before starting. :thumbsup:
devon: ping me when you're about to start, I'll have the restore-runner on standby.
anna: will do.
